newestRows.author: ethanoroshiba
newestRows.summary: The Go module path was `github.com/x402-foundation/x402/go` despite being at major version v2. Go requires that modules at major version ≥2 include the version suffix in their module path — without it, the `go/v2.*` git tags are invisible to the Go toolchain, forcing all consumers to use pseudo-versions instead of tagged releases.

newestRows.title: fix(examples/ts): align custom client env vars with .env-local
newestRows.author: feldmannn
newestRows.summary: The TypeScript custom client example at `examples/typescript/clients/custom/index.ts` reads `process.env.SERVER_URL` (which is not declared in this example's `.env-local`) and hardcodes the path `/weather`. As a result, developers following the `.env-local` template see no effect from their edits: the env-var fallback `http://localhost:4021` always wins, and the path is unconfigurable despite `.env-local` providing `ENDPOINT_PATH`.

rows.title: test(python/evm): add unit tests for FacilitatorWeb3Signer methods
